property_summary: For every caller whose tokenBalance is zero, a successful call to airDrop() must leave that caller's balance equal to the caller's PRIOR balance plus 20, i.e. tokenBalance(caller) == 20; the mutant adds only 10, so the post-airdrop balance is 10 and the rule is violated for any successful fresh caller.
change_summary: Changed the airDrop balance update to add 10 instead of 20.
